label: first copy step of length-9 sequences when echoing w (also u/a/0)
explanation: Very sparse unit (0.03% of steps), active only in the copy phase, almost entirely at t=10-11 in long sequences (L=9 holds 94% of mass, L=8 6%, never L<=6). 84% of mass is at recall_idx 1 (the step right after <DEL>, where the input is the fed-back first original token) and 15% at recall_idx 2. Input-token identity modulates strongly: w gives 64% of mass and all the top activations, then u, a, 0, with weaker g/m/t. Never fires during the original phase or at the delimiter. The predicate L==9 & recall_idx==1 & in_tok==w gets about 51% of dev mass with precision ~0.28: many such steps stay below threshold, and what decides which ones cross it is not captured by simple variables. Broadening the token set to w/u/a/0 and recall_idx 1-2 reaches ~0.9 mass recall but precision falls to ~0.04.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=u (+3.07), phase=2 & in_tok=w (+2.82), prev_tok=j (+2.67), in_tok=w (+2.60), phase=2 & in_tok=a (+2.50), orig0=0 (+2.15). Lower it: orig8=- (-2.07), orig2=o (-2.02), orig5=k (-1.93), next_out=- (-1.75).
